labels.label: pistons
labels.caption: A Toyota Supra (A80) 2JZ inline-six starts and revs. Used for the pistons — this is the earlier 2JZ, not the A90's B58.

labels.label: ac
labels.caption: A short mechanical/tool sound, as a stand-in for the A/C compressor. Not a recorded compressor.

labels.label: alt
labels.caption: The same mechanical/tool sound, as a stand-in for the alternator.

labels.label: belt
labels.caption: The same mechanical/tool sound, as a stand-in for the accessory drive belt. Not a recorded belt.

labels.label: pulley
labels.caption: The same mechanical/tool sound, as a stand-in for the crank pulley / damper.

labels.label: gearbox
labels.caption: A workshop ratchet, used as a mechanical stand-in for the ZF 8HP automatic. This car is an automatic; the clip is not a recorded 8-speed gearbox.

labels.label: tens
labels.caption: The same mechanical/tool sound, as a stand-in for the belt tensioners and idler.

labels.label: crank
labels.caption: The same A80 2JZ start-and-rev, for the crankshaft.

labels.label: caps
labels.caption: The same A80 2JZ start-and-rev, for the main bearing caps.

labels.label: cat
labels.caption: A later exhaust run from the same A80 2JZ recording, for the catalytic converter.

labels.label: head
labels.caption: The same A80 2JZ start-and-rev, for the cylinder head.

labels.label: block
labels.caption: A Toyota Supra (A80) 2JZ inline-six starts and revs — a stand-in for the A90's B58 3.0-litre straight-six block. Related architecture (turbo I6), but not a B58 recording.

labels.label: exhman
labels.caption: The same A80 2JZ exhaust run, for the exhaust manifold.

labels.label: fan
labels.caption: An industrial ventilation fan, used as a stand-in for the cooling fan. Not a car cooling fan.

labels.label: cover
labels.caption: The same A80 2JZ start-and-rev, for the engine cover.

labels.label: radiator
labels.caption: The same industrial fan, for air through the radiator.

labels.label: intake
labels.caption: A turbo blow-off / wastegate whoosh, for the intake and water-to-air intercooler.

labels.label: turbo
labels.caption: A turbo blow-off whoosh cut from a Peugeot 406 with an HKS blow-off valve — a stand-in for the B58's twin-scroll turbo. Not a Supra turbo recording.

labels.label: wp
labels.caption: The same industrial fan, used loosely for the coolant pump (cooling circuit). Not a recorded water pump.

labels.label: pan
labels.caption: A short metal hit, as a stand-in for the oil pan. Not a recorded sump.

labels.label: chassis
labels.caption: A short spring sound, for the chassis / floor pan.

labels.label: fsub
labels.caption: The same spring sound, for the front subframe.

labels.label: rsub
labels.caption: The same spring sound, for the rear subframe.

labels.label: susp
labels.caption: A short spring sound, for the coilover suspension. Not a recorded Supra damper.

labels.label: diff
labels.caption: A short metal hit, as a stand-in for the rear differential. Not a recorded diff.

labels.label: dshaft
labels.caption: The same metal hit, as a stand-in for the driveshaft.

labels.label: exhaust
labels.caption: A later exhaust run from the Toyota Supra (A80) 2JZ recording, for the exhaust and twin mufflers. Not the A90 B58 exhaust.

labels.label: tank
labels.caption: Water being poured from bottles, as a liquid-fill stand-in for the fuel tank.

labels.label: rack
labels.caption: The same spring sound, used loosely for the steering rack. Not a recorded rack.

ambient.caption: A quieter cruise/idle stretch from the same A80 2JZ recording, under the object page once sound is enabled.

ui.caption: A short UI tick for hovering a label. Optional — hook only if it feels right, and debounce it. This explode view is dense, so skip hover if it feels noisy.
